title: Electoral Region Format v0.1 - regions.json
description: All regions of one country. Cross-file checks (parent existence, ranks, cycles, defaultLocale) are done by tools/validate.mjs.

level.description: Level id. Must exist in country.json levels.

parentId.description: Id of the parent region. Only for hierarchical levels; null otherwise and for top-level regions.

names.description: Map of locale code to name. Must include the country's defaultLocale (checked by validator).

composedOf.description: Optional. Ids of the regions this region is made of. Used for non-hierarchical levels (e.g. a constituency composed of upazilas). Referenced ids must exist (checked by validator).

geometry.description: Optional. Relative path (inside the country folder) to a GeoJSON file. Geometry is never embedded in regions.json.
